system.description:
When the Sidereal uses this Charm, he exhales a long, silent breath that slips between the threads of the Tapestry of Creation and clears a space around the strand that represents the ship on which he sails. For the next scene, the ship sails smoothly regardless of fierce weather or high waves, moving as effortlessly as a toy ship across a map.

As a result, environmental penalties no longer affect the pilot's Sail rolls, and the ship takes no further damage from the harsh conditions for the rest of the scene.
